checks.description: Declares the Risk Tier of the task in a Risk Tier section (Declared: <tier>).
Does not cite the retired ~/.claude/skill-library/ directory.
Agent-targeted prompts do not name Claude-only Task/Skill/AskUserQuestion tools as callable.
Agent-targeted validation requires the external agent CLI marker in Risk Tier.
Mentions the prompt-craft harness validator command for saved prompts.
Requires saved prompt validation and treats chat-only prompt output as unvalidated.
Includes an explicit Acceptance Checklist section.
Acceptance Checklist requires expected behavior, target surface, verification method, and PASS evidence.
A named umbrella command claimed as equivalent is itself included in executable verification evidence.
Generated artifacts destined for commit require a tracked/ignored-state probe and exact staged-path evidence.
Includes a Harness Selection section that picks one harness type matched to the task shape.
Harness Selection states the chosen harness type and the reason for it.
Includes an Execution Loop Selection section that picks one of the six loop patterns and keeps reconciliation inside it.
Execution Loop Selection states the chosen pattern, the reason, and an explicit stop condition.
Includes the Spec-Implementation Reconciliation Loop section.
Requires checklist-level PASS, FAIL, and BLOCKED status.
Requires a structured Failure Signature log for failed checklist items.
Failure Signature contains expected, actual, verification, error, attempt, fix, and result fields.
Second occurrence of the same failure signature triggers smallest-unit scope reduction.
Third occurrence of the same failure signature becomes BLOCKED with required input.
Includes the De-Sloppify Pass cleanup gate.
Prompts choosing a long-lived loop (nanoclaw, infinite, continuous-pr, rfc-dag) or the gan harness must reference loop-status evidence.
Deliverables require the unified Completion Report format (Run status, Checklist Results, Run Summary, UNREPORTED rule).
Forbids final reporting while any checklist item remains FAIL.
Does not delegate reconciliation to /loop-start unless it performs checklist-level reconciliation itself.
Fast prompts carry the versioned execution marker and one top-level Dynamic Workflow Execution section.
The single Dynamic Workflow Execution section immediately follows the profile-specific anchor section.
Dynamic workflow prompts retain parallel investigation and implementation safety, verification, reconciliation, fallback, and repair-budget clauses.
Non-parity Grok receivers require a valid strict profile; strict writes require a concrete allowlist and baseline-aware tracked/staged/untracked scope audit.
The target-specific orchestration item appears exactly once as the last Acceptance Checklist item.
The target-specific orchestration evidence item appears exactly once inside Deliverables.

skills.name: goal
skills.procedure: Treat docs-perfection as one durable parent goal. Persist checkpoints in docs/work/docs-perfection/PROGRESS.md and unit outcomes in LEDGER.md. Keep the full objective intact: investigation package is the SoT for findings; repairs follow CHILD-GOALS only after investigation placement is confirmed. Do not mark parent GOAL completed while RQ-002 frontend manual remains external-unfixed or while any assigned RQ lacks evidence. Before COMPLETE, audit every Acceptance Checklist item against current files and command output.
